description: Reviewed optional Windows desktop process alternatives. Exact UA-pattern lookup; these are not equivalent UA conversions.

mappings.evidence: Spotify staff troubleshooting instructions identify Spotify.exe in Windows Task Manager.
Microsoft deployment documentation identifies the Windows sync app as OneDrive.exe.
First-hand Windows crash report on the Blizzard support forum identifies Hearthstone.exe and its installation path; this is user diagnostic evidence, not a Blizzard compatibility guarantee.
